title: 第4章 嫂子怀疑
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳看了一眼手机，笑着对胖子说：“老板，谢谢了。”

    “不客气不客气，”胖子笑得合不拢嘴，一边说着，一边从口袋里掏出一张名片，递到陈阳面前。

    “小兄弟，我叫王强，底下开了个玉石厂，以后你要是还有好的原石，尽管联系我，我一定给你最高价，绝不亏待你。”

    陈阳接过名片，快速扫了一眼，将王强的电话号码存进手机里，笑着说：“行，王大哥，那就这么说定了，以后我有好东西，一定先找你。”

    王强满意地点了点头，当即朝不远处的一个助手招了招手，示意他把那块翡翠抱走。

    他又和陈阳寒暄了两句，才带着助手匆匆离去。

    周围的摊主和看客见没了热闹，也纷纷散去。

    陈阳转头就看到了不远处站着的宋萌萌。

    此时她呆呆地看着陈阳，眼神空洞，整个人像块石头似的石化在那里，嘴巴微微张着，脸上还残留着未散的震惊。

    陈阳快步走到她身前，轻轻拍了拍她的胳膊，语气轻松：“嫂子，别愣着了，我们走吧。”

    宋萌萌这才猛地回过神，眼神依旧带着几分恍惚，抬头看着陈阳，满是不敢置信：“刚刚……刚刚那石头里，真的有翡翠？”

    陈阳笑着点头，语气平淡：“是啊，我运气好而已。”

    宋萌萌还是不敢相信，又追问：“那……那刚才那个胖子老板，真的给了你10万？”

    陈阳再次点头，晃了晃手里的手机，示意转账已经到账：“嗯，钱已经到账了。”

    “天呐！”宋萌萌惊呼一声，双手捂住嘴巴，眼睛瞪得圆圆的，脸上写满了震惊与羡慕，“4000块换10万，就一眨眼的功夫，这也太暴利了吧！”

    她上下打量着陈阳，眼神里满是疑惑，又带着几分不可思议：“陈阳，你老实说，你到底是怎么知道那石头里面有东西的？你是不是有什么秘诀？”

    陈阳随口说：“哪有什么秘诀，就是猜的，运气好罢了。”

    就在这时，刚才卖石头给陈阳的摊主，脸上堆着谄媚的笑容，连忙朝陈阳喊道：“小兄弟，过来看看啊！我这边还有好多好石头，都是精心挑选的，保准有好货！”

    周围其他几个摊位的老板，也纷纷反应过来，都笑着朝陈阳招手，语气热切：“小兄弟，来我这边看看，我这边也有好原石！”
content_en:
Chen Yang glanced at the phone, smiled and said to the fat man: "Thank you, boss."

"You're welcome, you're welcome," the fat man said with a grin from ear to ear, while taking out a business card from his pocket and handing it to Chen Yang.

"Little brother, my name is Wang Qiang, and I own a jade factory. If you still have good rough stones in the future, just contact me and I will give you the highest price and I will never treat you badly."

Chen Yang took the business card, glanced at it quickly, saved Wang Qiang's phone number in his phone, and said with a smile: "Okay, Brother Wang, it's settled. If I have good things in the future, I will definitely come to you first."

Wang Qiang nodded with satisfaction, and immediately waved to an assistant not far away, motioning him to take the piece of jade away.

He exchanged some pleasantries with Chen Yang before leaving in a hurry with his assistant.

Seeing the excitement, the surrounding stall owners and onlookers dispersed one after another.

Chen Yang turned around and saw Song Mengmeng standing not far away.

At this time, she stared at Chen Yang blankly, her eyes were empty, her whole body was petrified like a stone, her mouth was slightly open, and there was still lingering shock on her face.

Chen Yang walked quickly to her, patted her arm gently, and said in a relaxed tone: "Sister-in-law, don't be stunned, let's go."

Song Mengmeng suddenly came back to her senses. Her eyes were still in a trance. She looked up at Chen Yang, full of disbelief: "Just now... was there really jade in that stone just now?"

Chen Yang nodded with a smile and said in a calm tone: "Yes, I'm just lucky."

Song Mengmeng still couldn't believe it, and asked again: "Then... did that fat boss just give you 100,000?"

Chen Yang nodded again, shook the phone in his hand, and signaled that the transfer had arrived: "Well, the money has arrived."

"Oh my God!" Song Mengmeng exclaimed, covering her mouth with both hands, her eyes widened, her face full of shock and envy, "4,000 yuan for 100,000 yuan in the blink of an eye, this is such a huge profit!"

She looked Chen Yang up and down, her eyes filled with doubts and a bit of disbelief: "Chen Yang, honestly speaking, how did you know there was something in that stone? Do you have any secrets?"

Chen Yang said casually: "There is no secret. I just guessed and got lucky."

At this moment, the stall owner who had just sold stones to Chen Yang had a flattering smile on his face and shouted to Chen Yang: "Little brother, come and take a look! I still have a lot of good stones here, all carefully selected, I'm sure there will be good ones!"

The bosses of several other stalls around him also reacted. They all smiled and waved to Chen Yang with an eager tone: "Little brother, come and take a look at my place. I also have good rough stones!"
